sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/MoGe: [CVPR'25 Oral] MoGe: Unlocking Accurate ...
sources.snippet: MoGe is a powerful model for recovering 3D geometry from monocular open-domain images, including metric point maps, metric depth maps, normal maps and camera FOV. Check our websites (MoGe-1, MoGe-2, MoGe-3) for videos and interactive results!

sources.title: MLX
sources.snippet: MLX Examples - standalone examples in the MLX framework including image generation, speech and music generation, language model training and many more. MLX Swift Examples - examples in MLX Swift including LLM and VLM text generation, low-rank fine-tuning, and image generation with SDXL. Check out the growing community.
